text:
maria: Follow-up thread for the 2026-03-19 billing ingestion issue (delayed events + double-counted tokens). Need owners + ETAs for remediation so finance/support can notify customers. Remediation slate: 1) ingest dedupe fix, 2) idempotent backfill for 03/19-03/21, 3) invoice credits/manual adjustments, 4) alerting (ingest vs upstream delta), 5) postmortem update + recurring-pattern analysis.

ajay: I will take #1 (ingest dedupe). Triage today, patch + CI test tomorrow. ETA patch: 2026-03-25 10:00 PT.

kyla: I'll own #3 (credits). Plan: produce impacted subscription list, propose credit amounts, run 10-customer pilot then bulk. Pilot by 2026-03-26, bulk by 2026-03-30. Created FIN-4821 and FIN-4822.

sam: I'll do #2 (backfill). Posting SQL snippet for de-dup detection and will run a dry-run on staging by 3pm PT. Dry-run found ~2,364 duplicate token events, delta ~41,892 tokens. Scheduling production backfill 2026-03-25 01:30 UTC.

billing-bot: ingestion-job report 2026-03-24 06:00 UTC - processed=1,236,014 events, dup-detection=off (flag=0) :warning:

leo: I'll review infra impact for the dedupe patch tomorrow. Watch mem usage for dedupe window; may need a config knob. ETA review 2026-03-25 09:30 PT.

maria: Notes: similar to Dec 2025 incident (recurrence). @ajay add recurring-pattern section in postmortem and propose guardrails. Add alert: ingestion lag >5m AND delta(token_ingest, upstream_events) >0.5%. Action recap checklist: owners assigned (ajay/#1, sam/#2, kyla/#3, leo/review); dedupe patch + CI test (ajay) ETA 2026-03-25 06:00 UTC; backfill run (sam) ETA 2026-03-25 01:30 UTC; pilot credits (kyla) ETA 2026-03-26; alerts + postmortem updates (ajay + maria) ETA 2026-03-27; customer comms + invoice adjustments (kyla + finance) ETA 2026-03-30. Ping here to reassign.
